mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as capital flows into equities during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS <= 0.2% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals labor market weakness reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.0%.

failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both HOUST < 500.0 and RSAFS < 350000.0.
